column1: # Prusa-Touch partition table — matches BigTreeTech's stock K-Touch / Panda Touch
# layout exactly (read from the stock backup @ 0x8000) so:
#   - the app runs from a dual-OTA slot (self-update via our web page)
#   - we stay compatible with BTT's own /update OTA mechanism.
# 16 MB flash. App slots are 4.5 MB each (our app is ~1.3 MB — plenty of room).
